items.description: Floor cleaning, washing machine connection check, replacement of skirting boards in utility room and hallway
items.rationale: Escape of water from a hose is covered (2.4.2). Cleaning of affected surfaces (7.1.7h), source check (7.1.7e) and replacement of skirting boards (fixed trim, a building component under 4.2.2) are all covered repair costs. Both rooms were wetted, so no unaffected-room issue arises. Estimated at a fair market price for the combined work.

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying of utility room and hallway floor incl. drying unit and labour
items.rationale: Moisture measurement and drying, including equipment hire and labour, are covered under 7.1.7(b),(e),(g). Both rooms were wetted. A fair price for drying two rooms is assumed.

items.description: Assessment and drying of small framed decorative print from hallway
items.rationale: The print is movable household contents (4.3(d)), not insured under the buildings-only schedule. It is a mass-produced pine-framed poster with no particular value, so 5.2.6 does not apply and the restorer's work is not indemnified. t = 0.
